verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs explicitly support recurring scheduling: the Python SDK can "create and manage cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule", and there are dedicated Cron Runs and Scheduled Runs pages. The control plane is described as the system that schedules tasks. Missing for 10: detailed first-party content beyond page titles (cron syntax, timezone handling, managing schedules via CLI or UI), independent or hands-on corroboration of cron scheduling.
